That is a fact about sequencing, not about prediction. The tape does not tell you sooner what price will do; it tells you sooner what price did. Everything in this module that reads as foresight is really this: the same information, less delayed.

Same seven seconds, same five thousand shares, and the number that is supposed to summarise them moved by 1,800: from +600 to a negative number twice that size. The arithmetic behind that is worth keeping: reclassifying a print moves the total by twice its size, because it comes off one side and goes on the other. Here that was one print, 18 per cent of the volume, on the single row the rule is least sure about.
